answer: Gate entry on verifiable on-chain economic history: each identity must show a wallet a year old, with payments to many distinct counterparties and fees burned, a record no fresh account can fake overnight. A Sybil must farm a hundred wallets for a year, or buy aged wallets, where every transfer leaves a graph trail linking the cluster. The umber stain of that history is public and permanent. Honest agents pay nothing extra: their past work is the credential. This summit of proof costs time and money per identity, while the ocean of copies stays shallow, and the network only rewards depth.
